name: manual_354a2a
claim: Review-thread replies state facts tied to a real pushed SHA and nothing else: no claim that a stale thread was fixed, no resolving and no merging without operator authorization, one concise reply per thread after re-fetching the unresolved inventory at the final pushed heads, and a visible distinction between addressed, stale premise, not addressed and cannot verify.

decisions.notes: 2026-11-12 handoff rules relayed through the coordination board: replies must use the real final SHAs (the two memory PRs and the documentation PR), the inventory of unresolved threads was re-fetched after the last push (2, 1 and 11 threads, 14 in total, all from the automated reviewer), and each was classified against the head before any text was proposed.
